skill_name: Investigate the strategies countries use to reduce carbon emissions and explain how they are effective.
workflow: One strategy that countries can use to reduce their carbon emissions is implementing carbon pricing. Carbon pricing systems place a fee or a cap-and-trade system on the release of greenhouse gases. This is effective because it makes carbon-emitting activities more expensive, thus encouraging them to move away from these practices and toward more sustainable alternatives such as renewable energy.
